Elena (CSM): Sprucetec (Miguel) pinged: they need a term change from 12mo to 9mo due to budget cycle; also want to split payment: vendor will do 50% PO and 50% ACH. onboarding credit request: apply $2k trial credit now. renewal 2026-06-15.
Owen (Finance): 9mo term is nonstandard but doable with pricing pro-rate. need approval on pricing delta from RevOps. also PO+ACH split OK if vendor registers for ACH.
Miguel (Sprucetec): we'll sign a 9mo amendment. can you pro-rate pricing and confirm final invoice amount? will upload PO tomorrow.
Priyanka (Legal): add language to amendment clarifying term length, pro-rated fees, invoicing schedule, and that onboarding credit applies once invoiced. also require invoicing entity and remittance.
Elena (CSM): proposed amendment snippet: ```
Amendment: Term shall be amended to nine (9) months for the Renewal Period. Fees shall be pro-rated on a monthly basis. Customer may submit a Purchase Order for fifty percent (50%) of the pro-rated Renewal Fee; the remaining fifty percent (50%) shall be invoiced and payable via ACH within thirty (30) days of invoice. Onboarding credit of $2,000 shall be applied to the first invoice.```
OnboardBot: Note Onboarding credit balance for Sprucetec: $2,000 available.
Owen (Finance): fine, we'll need W-9 and ACH remittance plus RevOps sign-off on pro-rate numbers.
Miguel (Sprucetec): will provide docs. can we get 8 dev seats unlocked this Friday for integration testing?
Elena (CSM): yes we can open 8 non-prod seats. provisioning contingent on PO + docs.
Priyanka (Legal): I'll add standard clause about invoice adjustments if credits reduce to zero and add late payment terms.
Owen (Finance): once docs uploaded finance will send invoice for 50% deposit (PO portion) and ACH invoice for remainder. vendor onboarding ETA: 1 business day post-docs.
Miguel (Sprucetec): thanks, aiming to upload tonight.
